question: Should `talk.idleTimeoutS` apply to every configured macOS Talk session, or only sessions activated by Voice Wake?
rationale: The motivating issue is Voice Wake-specific, but current Talk state does not retain activation origin, so the PR creates broader manual-session behavior unless maintainers intentionally accept it.

options.title: Limit to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Add explicit activation-origin state and preserve indefinite manually started Talk sessions even when the idle timeout is configured.

options.title: Apply to all Talk sessions
options.body: Keep the general config behavior and explicitly accept auto-deactivation for configured manual and Voice Wake sessions.

options.title: Pause the public setting
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it until a broader Talk lifecycle policy is established.

recommendation.title: Limit to Voice Wake sessions
recommendation.body: Add explicit activation-origin state and preserve indefinite manually started Talk sessions even when the idle timeout is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the Voice Wake-to-Talk activation path at the center of the scope decision.
